answer_1.quote: An important phase in training these models is instruction tuning , which typically involves training LLMs on datasets curated by humans, either via supervised finetuning or preference optimization.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to instructions in chat scenarios, complex questions, and multi-turn conversations.

answer_2.quote: We make use of three well-established auto-evaluation benchmarks based on GPT4-as-a-Judge: AlpacaEval 2 , Arena-Hard  and MT-Bench .

answer_3.quote: As a judge (a special kind of acting), the model evaluates these responses via LLM-as-a-Judge prompting  and assigns rewards.
